module.name: EKS Cluster Install FLO
module.description: Install F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO) on AWS EKS — Helm release with BNK licensing and cert-manager ClusterIssuer wiring. AWS-tuned default for container_platform.

required.reason: Needs namespaces, FAR pull secret name, and FLO chart version wiring
FLO uses cert-manager ClusterIssuer for certificate management

required.name: flo_namespace
required.description: Namespace for FLO deployment. Auto-wired from bnk-prereqs.operator_namespace.

required.name: flo_version
required.description: FLO Helm chart version. Auto-wired from the BNK manifest parsed by bnk-prereqs.

required.name: far_secret_name
required.description: FAR image pull secret name. Auto-wired from bnk-prereqs.

required.name: cluster_issuer_name
required.description: ClusterIssuer name for FLO certificate management. Auto-wired from cert-issuer.

required.name: jwt_token
required.description: F5 BNK License JWT. Bind to a project secret in the deploy form.

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: EKS cluster name. Auto-wired from the cluster-register module.

optional.name: license_mode
optional.description: License mode: 'connected' (talks to F5 license server) or 'f5licenseproxy' (talks to a local F5 License Proxy).

optional.name: f5_license_proxy_url
optional.description: F5 License Proxy URL — used only when license_mode is 'f5licenseproxy'.

optional.name: cert_manager_ready
optional.description: Dependency gate from cert-manager (ensures CRDs exist before FLO references the ClusterIssuer).

optional.name: container_platform
optional.description: Container platform value passed to FLO. AWS enables cloud-aware gRPC and networking behavior — different from the upstream bnk/flo default of 'Generic'.

key_outputs.name: flo_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output indicating FLO is ready.

key_outputs.name: crds_installed
key_outputs.description: Gate output indicating FLO CRDs are registered with the cluster API.
